action.chatInput: send a message to the tab "{{detail}}"
action.tabRevert: drop the unsaved changes of the tab "{{detail}}"
action.browserControl: click, type or run scripts in the browser tab "{{detail}}"
action.worktreeRemove: delete the task and its worktree folder
action.worktreeRemoveBranch: delete the task, its worktree folder and its branch
action.workspaceRemove: remove the workspace and its tasks from the app, leaving their folders
action.workspaceMove: move the workspace in the sidebar
action.chatInterrupt: stop the turn of the tab "{{detail}}"
action.chatSettings: change the model, effort or mode of the tab "{{detail}}"
action.chatMode: change the permission mode of the tab {{detail}}
action.chatProfile: change the profile of the tab {{detail}}, going on with its conversation
action.chatProfileNew: change the profile of the tab {{detail}}, starting a new conversation
action.chatRewind: rewind the tab {{detail}} to before that message
action.chatRewindFiles: rewind the tab {{detail}} and its files to before that message
action.chatFork: copy the conversation of the tab "{{detail}}" into a new tab
action.chatRemoteControlOn: turn on Remote Control of the tab "{{detail}}"
action.chatRemoteControlOff: turn off Remote Control of the tab "{{detail}}"
action.noteRecord: record into the note "{{detail}}" with the microphone
action.noteRecordStop: pause or stop the recording of the note "{{detail}}"

failure.too-short: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
failure.conflict: Another device just changed the password. Try again.
failure.unavailable: Can't reach the server. Try again shortly.
failure.signed-out: You were signed out. Sign in again.
failure.too-heavy: This app can't open the key as the server locked it. Update NexusCode.
failure.account-auth: The server did not take this password. It may have been changed on another device. If this goes on, reset the password.
failure.device-key: A device's key could not be checked, so the account key was not changed. Try again in a while.
failure.needs-password: That device may hold the account key. Type the password to remove it and change the key.

key.resetDelayed: The new password takes effect in 72 hours, and a device that knows the current one can call it off meanwhile. Your other devices then ask for the new one.

pendingReset.self: This device asked to reset the account password. It takes effect {{when}}. Then connect again with the new password.
pendingReset.other: {{name}} asked to reset the account password. It takes effect {{when}}. If it was not you, call it off or remove that device.
pendingReset.cancelDescription: Type the account password now to call off the waiting reset.
pendingReset.removeDescription: Removing the device that asked for a reset calls the reset off. If that device has had the account key, the next step asks for the password to change the key, or removes it and keeps the key.
pendingReset.removeHolderDescription: This device has had the account key, and may still hold it. Removing it with the password changes the key, so a key it holds no longer connects. Without the password it can still be removed, which calls the reset off, but it keeps any key it holds.
